subject.main: Vertical Chinese educational infographic poster about ancient Yunmeng Ze marshland
subject.details: Central wetland landscape illustration showing vast marshland with reeds, water birds (egrets, herons, ducks), small wooden fishing boats, traditional Chinese pavilions and pagodas on distant shores, misty mountains in background, fish jumping from water, lotus flowers. Left sidebar has 4 rectangular info boxes each with a descriptive icon illustration. Right sidebar has 4 circular icon frames each containing a symbolic illustration.

elements.text: 云梦泽曾是中国最大的淡水湖泊湿地系统之一，古时位于现今湖北省，覆盖面积约四万平方公里。据《史记》和《楚辞》等历史文献记载，它曾是一片浩瀚的湿地，鱼虾众多，水鸟云集，生态丰富。千百年来，随着长江泥沙的不断淤积，加上人类长期的围垦造田活动，云梦泽逐渐演变成陆地和农田。至明清时期，大部分已干涸，如今仅剩洪湖、梁子湖等零星湖泊作为遗迹。这一地理变迁深刻反映了自然沉积作用和人类活动共同导致的巨大环境变化。
